objective: Prove that at every n = 2^m >= 4 the corner's return series in the box is 1/(1 + L(w^4)), L(z) = z + z^2 + z^4 + ... + z^n the trace polynomial of GF(2n); on the way, the doubling relation 1/r_2n(w) = 1/r_n(w^2) + w^4 between the sides n and 2n, and at every side n >= 3 the first deviation from the quadrant: the box's first-return series is the quadrant's plus w^(8n) plus higher terms.
title: The box law at every power of two
